description_en: Call `QueryIProductionJob` to get the status and result of an intelligent production job
description_zh: 调用QueryIProductionJob查询智能生产任务状态与结果
name: QueryIProductionJob

parameters.help_en: A token that ensures request idempotence
parameters.name: client_token

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created, in UTC

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was completed, in UTC

FunctionName.description_en:
The name of the algorithm to use. Valid values:

Cover: smart cover

VideoClip: video summary

VideoDelogo: video logo removal

VideoDetext: video text removal

CaptionExtraction: caption extraction

VideoGreenScreenMatting: green screen matting

FaceBeauty: video beautification

VideoH2V: horizontal-to-vertical video conversion

MusicSegmentDetect: chorus detection

AudioBeatDetection: beat detection

AudioQualityAssessment: audio quality assessment

SpeechDenoise: speech denoising

AudioMixing: audio mixing

MusicDemix: music source separation
FunctionName.description_zh:
需要使用的算法功能名称。取值：

Cover：智能封面
VideoClip：视频摘要
VideoDelogo：视频去图标
VideoDetext：视频去字幕
CaptionExtraction：字幕提取
VideoGreenScreenMatting：绿幕抠图
FaceBeauty：视频美颜
VideoH2V：视频横转竖
MusicSegmentDetect：副歌检测
AudioBeatDetection：节奏检测
AudioQualityAssessment：音质检测
SpeechDenoise：语音降噪
AudioMixing：音频混音
MusicDemix：声伴分离

Media.description_en:
The source file for the job. Set this to an OSS file URL if `Type` is `OSS`, or a media asset ID if `Type` is `Media`.
Valid OSS URL formats:

oss\://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
   In these formats, `bucket` is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path
Media.description_zh:
输入媒体。当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址，Type为Media时填入媒资ID。
OSS地址规则为：
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The input type. Valid values:

OSS: An OSS file URL.

Media: A media asset ID
Type.description_zh:
输入类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID

JobParams.description_en: A JSON object that contains the parameters for the algorithm job. The specific parameters vary depending on the selected algorithm
JobParams.description_zh: 算法作业参数，JSON对象，不同算法对应参数内容不同

Biz.description_en: The service that the media asset belongs to

Media.description_en:
The destination for the output. If the output `Type` is `OSS`, this parameter returns an OSS file URL. If the output `Type` is `Media`, it returns the specified or a newly generated media asset ID.

Valid OSS URL formats:

oss\://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
   In these formats, `bucket` is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path
Media.description_zh:
输出媒体。当Type为OSS时返回OSS地址，Type为Media时返回指定的媒资ID或新生成媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径

OutputUrl.description_en: The OSS URL of the output file. This value is returned only when `Type` is `Media`
OutputUrl.description_zh: 当Type=Media时，为指定输出文件OSS地址

Type.description_en:
The media type. Valid values:

OSS: An OSS file URL.

Media: A media asset ID
Type.description_zh:
媒体类型：
OSS：OSS路径
Media：媒资ID

OutputFiles.description_en: An array of output file paths

items.description_en: The path and name of the generated file
items.description_zh: 生成的文件路径与名称

OutputUrls.description_en: An array of output file URLs

items.description_en: The accessible URL of the generated file
items.description_zh: 生成的文件可访问URL路径

Result.description_en: The algorithm output, returned as a JSON string. The structure of the output varies based on the `FunctionName`. For more information, see the additional notes below
Result.description_zh: 算法输出的结果信息，不同FunctionName的输出不同，以JSON格式输出，详见下面的补充说明

Priority.description_en:
The job's priority within the pipeline.

A larger value indicates a higher priority. The highest priority is 10.

Default: 6
Priority.description_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的优先级。

最高优先级：10。

默认值：6

Status.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Queuing: The job is awaiting processing.

Analyzing: The job is being processed.

Fail: The job failed to complete.

Success: The job completed successfully
Status.description_zh:
作业状态。取值：
Queuing：排队中。
Analysing：分析中。
Fail：失败。
Success：成功

UserData.description_en: The user data. The system returns this value unchanged
UserData.description_zh: 用户自定义数据，获取结果时原样返回
